title: A multi-temporal dataset for mapping burned areas in the Brazilian Cerrado using time series of remote sensing imagery
abstract: arXiv:2609.23687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces a multi-temporal tabular dataset derived from satellite images to map burned areas in the Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park, in Goi\'as, Brazil, covering the years 2020 to 2022. The dataset contains blue, green, red, and near-infrared bands, as well as the BAI, EVI, GEMI, NDVI, and NDWI spectral indices from the WFI sensor on the CBERS-4A, CBERS-4, and AMAZONIA-1 satellites, organized into a regular grid. We applied the Random Forest classifier to develop and validate models based on samples labeled as totally burned, partially burned, and non-burned. Two classification approaches were tested: one combining burned and non-burned areas into binary classes and another distinguishing between totally burned (TB), partially burned (PB), and non-burned (NB) classes. Seven validation approaches assessed different post-classification combinations, focusing on accuracy, precision, recall, and intersection over union (IoU)

translated_title: 一个利用遥感影像时间序列绘制巴西塞拉多草原火烧区域的多时相数据集
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一个源自卫星影像的多时相表格数据集，用于绘制巴西戈亚斯州查帕达杜斯维德罗斯国家公园的火烧区域，覆盖2020年至2022年。该数据集包含来自CBERS-4A、CBERS-4和AMAZONIA-1卫星上WFI传感器的蓝、绿、红和近红外波段，以及BAI、EVI、GEMI、NDVI和NDWI光谱指数，并以规则网格形式组织。我们应用随机森林分类器，基于标记为完全燃烧、部分燃烧和未燃烧的样本开发并验证了模型。研究测试了两种分类方法：一种是将燃烧区域和未燃烧区域合并为二元类别，另一种是区分完全燃烧（TB）、部分燃烧（PB）和未燃烧（NB）三个类别。七种验证方法评估了不同的分类后组合，重点关注准确率、精确率、召回率和交并比。
tldr: 该论文发布了一个基于CBERS-4A、CBERS-4和AMAZONIA-1卫星影像的巴西塞拉多草原火烧区域多时相数据集，并利用随机森林分类器验证了区分完全燃烧、部分燃烧和未燃烧区域的有效分类方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-temporal dataset derived from CBERS-4A, CBERS-4, and AMAZONIA-1 satellite imagery for mapping burned areas in the Brazilian Cerrado, validated with Random Forest classifiers that distinguish totally burned, partially burned, and non-burned areas.
